verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes official SDKs across virtually all major languages/platforms ("Drop in the SDK... If you use it, we probably support it"), backed by a broad official docs site and llms.txt entry, plus first-party MCP server and CLI for agentic/AI workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality/breadth, and no explicit list of supported languages/frameworks in the evidence pack.
